title: Bills vs Vikings 23–6: Josh Allen Ties Peyton Manning 🦬 #MNF #shorts
description:

Allen's 322 regular-season touchdowns tie Peyton Manning for the most in a player's first 10 years.

title: England's Most Capped Players: Harry Kane Level With Shilton on 125 🦁 #shorts
description:

Kane, England's record scorer with 91 goals, can break the record against Croatia in the Nations League at Wembley on Thursday 12 November.

description:

title: NBA Record for Blocks in a Game: 17 🤯 Can Wembanyama Catch It? #shorts
description:
The NBA record for blocks in a game is 17, set by Elmore Smith for the Lakers against the Trail Blazers on 28 October 1973. Manute Bol twice blocked 15 and Shaquille O'Neal blocked 15 in 1993, while Victor Wembanyama set the playoff record with 12 blocks against the Timberwolves on 4 May 2026. On Monday Wembanyama had 40 points and eight blocks against the Suns.
